fieldMapping.note: HubSpot deal ID used as external identifier for upsert
Extracted from deal properties to match Salesforce Account
Deal name mapped to Salesforce Account Name
Deal amount mapped to Salesforce Annual Revenue field
Deal close date mapped to custom Salesforce date field

assumptions: The HubSpot deal webhook payload includes properties: deal_id, website_domain, deal_name, deal_amount, and deal_close_date.
Salesforce has a custom external ID field (e.g., HubSpot_Account_ID__c) on the Account object to support upsert operations.
If no matching Account is found by website domain, a new Account will be created with the deal's Name, Annual Revenue, and Close Date values.
The integration will perform a SOQL search on Account.Website using the website_domain value from the HubSpot payload before deciding to upsert or create.

notes: HubSpot webhooks deliver payloads directly to the configured endpoint without requiring authentication on the receiver side; security is enforced via HubSpot signature verification (X-HubSpot-Signature header)
HubSpot sends webhooks as POST requests with JSON payload containing 'dealId' and nested 'properties' object
Properties include deal_id, website_domain, deal_name, deal_amount, deal_close_date as assumed in the plan
Webhooks fire on both creation and updates; filter by changeSource='USER_INTERFACE' to capture manual changes only
No built-in filtering at subscription level; endpoint must handle high volume and deduplicate events
Secure endpoint by verifying X-HubSpot-Signature header using HubSpot secret token stored as environment variable
Required environment variable: HUBSPOT_WEBHOOK_SECRET (for signature verification)
External ID field assumed to be HubSpot_Account_ID__c (custom field on Account object)
If record exists (matched by external ID), updates fields; if not, creates new record
Response includes 'created' boolean (true if created, false if updated) in API v46.0+
HTTP 200 OK for update, HTTP 201 Created for insert
Requires valid Salesforce access token via OAuth 2.0 Bearer token
Environment variable: SALESFORCE_ACCESS_TOKEN (must be refreshed via refresh token flow)
Note: Must first query Account by Website to confirm match before upsert (per plan assumptions); this endpoint assumes pre-check passed
